desc: Prove that applying a range increment to the contiguous preimage of a contest interval correctly simulates each contest.
Implement a lazy segment tree over initial ratings 1 through 500000 storing maximum current values plus lazy range-add tags.
Implement threshold boundary searches for first value >= L and first value > R in the monotone current-value sequence.
For every contest, range-add 1 to the preimage interval [first_ge(L), first_gt(R)-1], if nonempty.
Answer each query by a segment-tree point query and verify against all samples.
